source_scope: Round 75: printed Chinese Chapters 1162–1171; Bqquge primary text reviewed through visible continuations. Vietnamese title/index comparison checked on Cơm Nguội, Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế, and Xa Lộ Sách; local numbering diverges and some chapters are split. Vietnamese pages were used only for title alignment; gated bodies did not supply mechanics.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Cao Xing receives the repaired original Storm Axe as a Quasi-artifact; it lacks a core godhead and requires level 190.
Imperial resources are delivered for mass Hero promotion; rounded shipment narration differs slightly from exact altar-consumption values. 97,164 promotions are displayed.
Mass promotion completes; second War God trial ring awards Heart of Genesis and one War Plane Teleport Stone.
Heart of Genesis is fused with Bloom's Genesis Shield to create semi-artifact Genesis Shield–Anodite; its defense, linking, healing and revival field are recorded.
Abyss invasion is staged; Death Bag + Necromantic Flute are the planned means to carry Oliviaus past the rule seal.
Oliviaus is successfully carried out of the Church divine realm; 30 km Heavenly Fortune Ark stays outside the Abyss with one Destiny Judgment launcher use.
Church leadership has secretly agreed to ally against Cao; team reaches the Abyss portal. No battle loot is obtained.
Abyss entry awards 50,000,000 Exploration XP and 100,000 Prestige; Church Holy Spirit Absolute Seal trap disables spatial transport and debuffs the team.
Starfire reinforcements arrive; battle with Church begins, with no reward closure.
Abyss confrontation continues unresolved. Shield absorption, damage outputs and combat debuffs are recorded as battle observations, not loot.

unresolved_conflicts: Ch1163 shipment narration uses rounded quantities while altar system display reports exact consumption values; both are retained rather than normalized.
Ch1163 shows 97,164 new Hero promotions after 120,000 gather and 25,000 are held back; preserve displayed outcome.

Vietnamese edition chapter numbering diverges materially: Cơm Nguội and Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế Ch1162 title an ice-statue goddess story, while Xa Lộ Sách local Ch1162 is a split chapter on demigod breakthrough/return to territory. These titles do not establish the Chinese printed Ch1162 story contents or item facts.
No result is shown for the Abyss battle by Ch1171; no victory/loot should be inferred.
